Our discussion begins with a case report describing the use of botulinum injections in a patient with classic stiff-person syndrome and concludes with a review of the literature on this topic.

A 38-year-old female with anxiety, depression, and Grave’s disease presented with several months of diffuse mus
cle pain and spasms. She had previously been diagnosed
with hyperthyroid myopathy as well as rhabdomyolysis.
